title: cassia granulata
intro: Cassia granulata, commonly known as Senna auriculata, is a small deciduous shrub native to tropical and subtropical regions. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as a natural laxative due to its anthraquinone glycosides, which stimulate bowel movements and relieve constipation. The bioactive constituents of Cassia granulata include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, contributing to its therapeutic actions such as diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The plant's anthraquinones have been found to exhibit significant biological activities, including antimicrobial and cytotoxic properties.
